potentials.name: Epiphany Bonus
potentials.text: When entering Chaos, obtain 1 random Rare Card with an activated Epiphany.

potentials.name: Basic Card Upgrade
potentials.text: Increase Damage, Shield, and Healing Amounts of Basic Cards by 2/20%.

potentials.name: Common Card Upgrade
potentials.text: Increase Damage, Shield, and Healing Amounts of Common Cards by 2/20%.

potentials.name: Basic Card Proficiency
potentials.text: Add a 50% chance to create 1 Homing Laser L to Pulse Fire.

potentials.name: Unique Card Upgrade
potentials.text: Increase Damage, Shield, and Healing Amounts of Unique Cards by 2/20%.

potentials.name: Basic Card Proficiency
potentials.text:
+5% Damage Amount to Sereniel's Pulse Fire.
If Sereniel's Critical Chance is greater than 20%, add an additional +5% to the modifier.

potentials.name: Divine Epiphany Adaptation
potentials.text: Increases the chance for a Divine Epiphany to appear by 25%.

potentials.name: Unique Stat Upgrade
potentials.text:
If Sereniel’s Critical Chance is 20% or higher, +10% Instinct Attribute Damage Amount
If Critical Chance is 40% or higher, add an additional +5% to the modifier

manifestEgo.name: Sleeping Memory
manifestEgo.text: +100% Damage to Pale Shooting Star, and change the number of procable Homing Laser cards to 5.

manifestEgo.name: Awakening Memory
manifestEgo.text:
At the start of battle, create 2 Homing Laser L, each with 1 increased Hit Count and applied with Haste.
At the start of the turn, if Homing Laser is one of the cards drawn, Draw 1 card.

manifestEgo.name: Vivid Memory
manifestEgo.text: +150% Damage Amount to Death Halo, and apply Haste to each Homing Laser L that is moved by Death Halo.

manifestEgo.name: Inner Memory
manifestEgo.text:
For each Homing Laser that is moved to hand on Ravage, Sereniel gains a Firepower Amp effect.
Firepower Amp: +25% Damage Amount to Sereniel’s Attack Cards for 1 turn (max 2 stacks)

manifestEgo.name: Complete Memory
manifestEgo.text: Increase the level of [Basic Card Upgrade], [Unique Card Upgrade], and [Common Card Upgrade] in Potentials by 3.

manifestEgo.name: Liberated Memory
manifestEgo.text:
At the start of battle, +20% to Sereniel’s Weakness Damage Amount.
At the start of the turn, inflict 1 Instinct Weakness to the enemy with the highest HP.
On Ravage by an ally, Sereniel inflicts 80% Damage × max Tenacity count of the target to that target.
